video_title: Sean Elliott - Spurs Still Have a Shot to WIN Finals!!

quotes.speaker: Sean Elliott
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' young team learning from late-game turnover mistakes
quotes.excerpt: we've had so many of those type of turnovers this year, Michelle, that it's frustrating
quotes.quote: We've had so many of those type of turnovers this year, Michelle, that it's frustrating because we are such a young team. You want to see us continue to learn from those mistakes, but not at that moment. In those moments, Mitch likes to allow his team to run so the Knicks don't set up their defense. Maybe you call a timeout in that situation, but all year this year we've been successful in those situations where Victor will push the ball or maybe pass it to Steph. It was just a miscommunication.

quotes.speaker: Sean Elliott
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' young roster mentally fatigued from long playoff run
quotes.excerpt: I feel like our guys maybe were a little mentally gassed from that seven-game series
quotes.quote: I feel like our guys maybe were a little mentally gassed from that seven-game series because again, they're so young. They haven't been this far before. They didn't really understand the playoffs coming in. So it felt like our guys were a little mentally tired, especially all the mistakes they made throughout that ball game. And so, yeah, I think there's something to that. I think not just them, but our entire team was a little mentally fatigued. When you're mentally fatigued, you're physically fatigued.

quotes.speaker: Sean Elliott
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' physical play causing problems for Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: KAT has done a great job getting physical with him, forcing him out of his spots
quotes.quote: KAT is a smart player. He's been around for a long time. They got Jeremy Sochan over there who's been on our team for four years and understands. KAT has done a great job getting physical with him, forcing him out of his spots. But I think a little bit of that is our guys too, Victor figuring out how to release contact, how not to wrestle the whole time with Karl-Anthony Towns, how to get the ball sooner, and make a quicker decision.

quotes.speaker: Sean Elliott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's perimeter scoring creates defensive mismatches for Spurs
quotes.excerpt: I feel like Jalen Brunson presents a little bit bigger problem because he shoots the three-ball more
quotes.quote: I feel like Jalen Brunson presents a little bit bigger problem because he shoots the three-ball more so than Shai Gilgeous-Alexander does. He plays the same type of game where he likes to create that contact and get to the foul line, but I feel like he's a better finisher around the rim. We had a little bit of experience where you get a little bit of a rhythm against a guy like Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, and you can apply what you learned going into the Finals. The Knicks are trying to set high screens so they get the mismatch that they want on the perimeter, allowing him to go to work. And then you don't have a guy like Stephen Curry, Dylan Harper, De'Aaron Fox, or Dewayne Dedmon on him.

quotes.speaker: Sean Elliott
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's potential as a future NBA superstar
quotes.excerpt: At the beginning of the season, I talked to Avery Johnson, I said, 'Look, young man's a superstar.'
quotes.quote: At the beginning of the season, I talked to Avery Johnson, I said, 'Look, young man's a superstar.' He's a superstar, plain and simple. He plays with so much poise, plays beyond his years. He did so many things this year. A lot of people were focusing on Victor Wembanyama, and then you have a lot of national guys that don't watch a lot of our games. They may watch Victor, but they don't focus on that young man. He did so many things this year that made you stand up and say, 'What in the world is going on?' That kid is a star. Playing in simple, when he gets his time, he's going to be a star. He didn't get any credit for what he did this year because Cooper Flagg had a phenomenal year, Khan Cunniple had a terrific year as well, but this guy is as good as any rookie in the class.

quotes.speaker: Sean Elliott
quotes.summary_phrase: Balancing the Spurs' roster with Harper, Fox, and Curry
quotes.excerpt: You can't ask De'Aaron Fox to really go to the bench
quotes.quote: You can't ask De'Aaron Fox to really go to the bench. He did a great job deferring this year and allowing Stephen Curry to bring the ball up, to allow Dylan Harper to really flourish. Stephen Curry is a starter as long as he's going to be in the Spurs uniform. So I don't know if you ask one of those guys to... you can't ask De'Aaron Fox to really go to the bench. So I don't know if Dylan Harper is going to want to accept that role the whole time. Is he going to want to be a guy like Manu Ginobili where he continues to come off the bench even though he's an All-Star caliber player? I don't know. The young man's very, very confident. He knows how good he is. At some point, he's going to want to be a starter.

quotes.speaker: Sean Elliott
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson's coaching success and accountability with the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: He's been phenomenal. He's been unbelievable, actually.
quotes.quote: He's been phenomenal. He's been unbelievable, actually. I've seen Mitch in the locker room addressing those guys before the game, after the game, at halftime. He gets after them, and he's got a little bit of pop in him now. He was under pop for eight or nine years. He does not let his guys slide. There's no slippage. He holds everybody accountable, and he's done a phenomenal job just again, like working with the guys on the floor, mixing guys in and out. His rotations have been pretty solid all year long. I thought Mitch was the coach of the year, honestly. We were supposed to win 40 games. That's what we were projected to win. We were supposed to win, be 10th or finish 10th in the Western Conference. Here we are at second and 62 wins.
